name: Dr. Hartwell
summary: Dr. Hartwell was Armitage's personal physician in Arkham, summoned to treat him after his exhausting decipherment of Wilbur Whateley's diary left him collapsed and delirious.
description: Dr. Hartwell, Armitage's physician, called to see him and insisted he cease his exhausting work on Wilbur Whateley's diary, but Armitage refused; Hartwell was summoned again that evening and put the exhausted scholar to bed, receiving no explanations for his condition.

sources.quote: Some time before noon his physician, Dr. Hartwell, called to see him and insisted that he cease work.
He made no explanations to Hartwell
